purpose: Separate easy context mismatch learning from adversarial unanswerability without changing the attention-only reader.

b1_cross_pair_500.handwritten: 3/5 answerable probes exact; neutral unsupported password was answered as 'hilltop' with p_answerable=0.96484375.

b2_official_only_500.data: 81% N2 answerable, 19% official SQuAD2 unanswerable; starts from B1
b2_official_only_500.finding: Sequential adversarial fine-tuning catastrophically forgot B1's useful answer/refusal separation.

b3_mixed_replay_500.data: 70% N2 answerable, 15% cross-pair, 15% official SQuAD2 unanswerable; starts from B1
b3_mixed_replay_500.finding: Replay prevents total collapse but does not recover useful strict-threshold coverage on adversarial negatives.

b4_entity_binding_500.data: 60% N2 answerable, 10% entity binding positive, 15% cross-pair, 15% missing entity
b4_entity_binding_500.finding: Synthetic entity binding learned, but the neutral unsupported password probe was still answered.

b5_relation_binding_500.data: 50% N2 answerable, 10% entity positive, 10% relation positive, 10% each cross/entity-missing/relation-missing
b5_relation_binding_500.finding: Relation binding improved the synthetic control but did not transfer to a neutral natural unsupported query.

b6_official_negative_500.data: B5 replay plus 15% official SQuAD2 unanswerables
b6_official_negative_500.validation_status: invalid_for_selection: development data used the public SQuAD2 validation partition later used by N0

b7_clean_split_500.data: B6 mixture; train and development are disjoint deterministic partitions of source train data
b7_clean_split_500.finding: The reader remains useful but the standalone answerability score shifts across the external distribution.

decision: Do not extend the standalone answerability-head curriculum unchanged. B6 contaminated the N0 diagnostic through development-split overlap; B7 fixed that split and still showed severe cross-distribution calibration shift. Treat N0 as observed diagnostic data and next test a different grounding signal or a rigorously matched calibration set.
